display.attractionName: The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh

description: Inside Owl's house, a framed picture shows Mr. Toad handing over the deed to Owl. It is a tribute to the ride that used to occupy this building, and a sweet one if you know the history.

whereToLook.scene: Owl's house scene, the pictures on the walls
whereToLook.exactSpot: A framed picture of Mr. Toad handing the deed to Owl.

bestTip: Look at the framed pictures as the room rocks rather than at the characters.
funFacts: The ride took over this building from Mr. Toad's Wild Ride in the late 1990s, and this painting makes the handover official.
